latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Free Text to Video Creator v1.0.0

- Instantly converts text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, plain text up to 500MB) into 1080p MP4 videos using a cloud rendering pipeline.
- Seamless video generation for content creators, marketers, and bloggers—no filming required.
- Fast processing (typically 1–2 minutes per video) with free starter credits available via quick token registration.
- Supports uploads, editing, background music, text overlays, and custom aspect ratios.
- Exports in popular formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, MKV, GIF, JPG, PNG, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC.
- Simple commands for downloading, checking credit balance, status updates, and previewing or refining video drafts.
